risk_note: DSX-51a (fix program DSX-107, not a 规划/05 row, so numbered after DSX-51; orchestrator D10-1037; inventory couli-runs/F1-frontend/dsx107-inventory.md). Admin modals get antd's default motion back: transitionName / maskTransitionName removed from 28 unmount-style Modals; the two relations dialogs (InviterChangeDialog, LevelChangeDialog) are now unmount-style too, return focus to the trigger in an effect and keep the 30409 explanation state in UserRelationsCard, so the frozen admin-user-relations cases stay green with default motion; StepUpModal keeps transitionName='' on purpose (code dialog measured and screenshotted right after opening), commented with DSX-107 / D10-1037. Reduced motion turns antd motion off through createAntdTheme's reducedMotion (App and the login page follow the system setting; admin-antd SOURCE#1 wiring kept). Loading anti-flash on motionSkeletonShowDelayMs: all 14 Tables use delayedLoading(flag, useLoadingClock()), the 5 Spins use a shared DelayedSpin. Dashboard todo cards are hoverable with token shadows on hover and focus. No frozen test changed or in conflict. Tables on the funds pages only change their loading indicator timing. Rule tests by an independent Claude; independent Claude spec-test review r1 pass (two S2 written into the implementation constraints and done); red on the local container (15 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: local container browser run 206 green; container verify-fast OOM-killed at tsc twice, host admin jsdom rule tests 1494/1494, tsc / eslint / prettier stand in, CI runs full verification. Non-funds logic; reviewed with the money checklist because funds-page tables are touched. Codex usage limit: independent Claude money review r1 pass, no findings (D10-823 ④). Written by hand.
